text: Phone has issues. My refurbished iPhone 8 has had issues from day one. I tried to email and call the vendor for a replacement but I never got a response.

Great service. I bought the iPhone 8 256. It looked like new when I received it. It did not come in the original iPhone box. It came in a cardboard box with the plug in to charge it and the little metal piece for SIM card. It worked great in every aspect except that I noticed the sound quality was not as good as my iPhone 5s, the sound was more “tinny” sound, probably not noticeable to others, but it was for me. I don’t know if it was a defect or how the iPhone 8 was made. It just startled me when I would use it for an alarm clock playing music. I did not have any problem at all returning the iPhone. The package came with a card that had their phone number and email address, backed by Amazon.

Broken phone, going back today. Received this iPhone 8 in the mail this afternoon. Came with a stuck home button, broken vibrate mode, nonfunctioning speaker phone, and randomly shuts off. Started the return process within several hours of receiving phone. Seller is CR Land.

Conversations interrupted/broken up;reception lost/disconnected.. Senior citizen. Employer requested upgrade. Technologically challenged. Didn't need bells, whistles, apps. Felt used/refurbished would be acceptable. Son assisted with product selection. Apple iPhone 8 functionality good, battery recharging frequent, conversations interrupted/broken up, reception lost/disconnected. Request refund. Will probably purchase brand new now. Thank you.

Avant Solutions Quality Control. This is the second refurbished Iphone 8 I have ordered from Avant Solutions in the last month. Both Iphones had deficiencies that rendered a return for refund; the first had a worn-out recharge plug port that allowed the plug to fall out easily. The second was a malfunctioning speaker. If you can overlook these items, the rest of the Iphone functions worked as expected, and so the price you pay for the refurb phone may excuse these deficiencies.

Great seller: PDI Mobile - backs up the products. I was looking for an older model iPhone with a good amount of life left in it. Since the 8 isn’t sold new anywhere, this refurbished option seemed worth a try. Upon arrival the phone was unlocked and in great shape with only a few minor scrapes on the outside edge; battery life was at 88% of original. The only small problem I was having was that the response to touch on the screen was intermittent, something with which I could probably manage. I decided to ask the seller about a replacement; once I started the return process (with a request for a replacement) the seller communicated very quickly and had a label for me to mail the old phone back that same day. The replacement came in as quickly as the old went out. It had a more responsive touch screen and even better battery life.

Refund. The iPhone 8 was not compatible with my service. But when I ordered it, it said unlock. I’ve bought a few and they were good. I don't know why this one didn’t. I’ve sent it back but have not got refund back yet

Warning. Problems I’m having with my iPhone 8. Touchscreen doesn’t always work, screen flickers/glitches, volume doesn’t always work. Sometimes my phone doesn’t even ring at all and sometimes it rings super loud. Lastly the battery I’m having issues with the battery, it dies very quickly and takes a lot longer to charge than it should. Unfortunately I bought the phone on July 5th 2020 and started having all these problems in October 2020 which puts me past the warranty date so I am stuck either using a phone with problems or paying out of pocket to get it fixed. Pros: I received my phone promptly by guaranteed delivery date.

Bad phone. We purchased a iPhone 8 in November, it was working ok. The speaker goes in and out only when the phone is used, and we couldn’t figure out why. Well now The speaker doesn’t work at all and the return ran out 1 month ago. I don’t feel this phone was completely checked before it was sent to us.
Bad iPhone 8. Take too long for refund for a defective phone. The only review needed is the quality of the phone. It had a shaky camera. I should get a refund no questions asked!
